name: clikcode
description: ClikCode — a local-first AI coding runtime

scripts.test:all: pnpm run test && pnpm run test:router
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js --help && node dist/index.js --human doctor

//dependencies: EMPTY ON PURPOSE, and verified by the build: `dependencies` holds only what dist/
imports at RUNTIME, and scripts/build.mjs fails if one is missing and warns about
extras. chalk, commander, conf, cross-spawn and marked are inlined into dist/index.js,
and @clikcode/router (a private, source-only workspace package) is bundled into
dist/*.cjs, so all of those are devDependencies. @basetenlabs/performance-client is a
native addon that must never be bundled (FORCE_EXTERNAL in the build); @ai-sdk/baseten
no longer imports it, so it is a devDependency pinned for the day it comes back — at
which point build:strict fails until it is moved here.
